channel.title: The Presidency
channel.desc: Author Kate Storey gives a behind the scenes look at the Kennedys' Hyannis Port refuge -- the scene of JFK's 1960 election victory and where Jackie gave her Camelot interview to Theodore White after the president was assassinated in November 1963.
